About Us

A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. From the multi-cultural strength of our global organisation to the sustainable and innovative ways we work to bring people together, there’s something for everyone to get stuck into. And that’s where you come in.

Job Description

Job Title: AI Intern, Supply Chain

Rail Pass Type: Internship/Co-op (Full-time/Hybrid)

Departure and Arrival Date (Start -End): January 2027 - December 2027 (12 months)

Vacancy: 1

Toronto Location: 100 Consilium Place, Scarborough, ON M1H 3E3

Work hours/week: 40

Pay Details: $23-$30 CAD hourly

Stations on Your Journey:     

Welcome and Onboarding Station 



- Intern Orientation   
- Online Onboarding Curriculum
- Buddy Program for mentorship and guidance  

Hands-On Work Station 



- Real-world projects with top industry talent 
- Paid internship + paid vacation 
- Hybrid work model  
- A chance to build your career with a global leader driving digital transformation and innovation that helps support sustainable future

Networking Station     



- "Ask Me Anything" with the Executive Committee    
- Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)  
- Social Intern Events: Coffee Breaks, Onsite/Offsite events
- Business Intern Events: Intern Showcase & Graduation ceremony
- Company Social Events: Holiday Party, Employee BBQs, Golf tournament, etc.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and tech-savvy co-op student to join our Supply Chain team for a 1-year term. This role is ideal for a student with a passion for automation, data, and artificial intelligence who wants to make a tangible impact on how supply chain processes are executed and optimized.

The successful candidate will support the development, customization, and deployment of AI-driven tools and automation solutions that enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and strategic value of supply chain operations.

The Successful Candidate Will Gain



- Hands-on experience applying AI and automation in a real-world business context.
- Exposure to supply chain operations and enterprise systems.
- Opportunity to contribute to meaningful digital transformation initiatives.
- Mentorship from experienced professionals in supply chain and technology.

Key Areas of Responsibility



- Collaborate with Supply Chain, and IT teams to identify automation opportunities within supply chain workflows.
- Assist in the design, development, and deployment of AI tools (e.g., chatbots, document analyzers, predictive models) tailored to supply chain needs.
- Customize existing AI solutions to align with internal processes and compliance requirements.
- Support integration of AI tools with supply chain platforms (e.g., ERP systems, internal management tools, price lists).
- Conduct testing, validation, and performance monitoring of deployed solutions.
- Document processes, user guides, and training materials for internal stakeholders.
- Stay current with emerging technologies in AI, machine learning, and supply chain automation.

Required Skills And Experience



- Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Technology Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
- Strong interest in procurement, supply chain, and business operations.
- Hands-on experience with Python.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency with standard computer applications and the ability to learn new systems and concepts quickly.
- Ability to work both independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively within a cross-functional team.
- Ability to apply technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and sound judgment to support supply chain systems and processes.

Preferred Qualifications



- Co-op student available for a 12-month term, with at least one additional academic term remaining after completion of the internship.
- Previous co-op or internship experience is an asset.
- Power Automate or other automation tools is an asset.
- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and tools (e.g., OpenAI, Azure AI, TensorFlow) is a plus. 
- Scientific background or additional business education or experience considered a plus.

Ready to Begin Your Journey? 

Tap your ticket and apply today.

TALOS: INSTITUTIONAL FABRIC FOR THE DIGITAL ASSET MARKET

Founded in 2018, Talos https://www.talos.com provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.




SOFTWARE ENGINEER INTERN, DEALER

Talos is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join our Dealer team for the Summer 2027. This intern will work on a critical project related to our high-performance trading systems, contributing to tools that support trading decision-making and performance evaluation. Success in this role will involve designing and building components that enhance our algorithmic capabilities while adding new features to existing infrastructure.

This is a 12-week internship running from June 1, 2027  to August 27, 2027

About Dealer: The Dealer platform provides trading, liquidity management, risk controls, and post-trade infrastructure that enables broker-dealers to service institutional clients across multiple venues. This includes order routing, market data aggregation, credit and risk management, position management, and settlement workflows.

Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: https://github.com/talostrading/sonic https://github.com/talostrading/sonic




RESPONSIBILITIES 

 - Collaborate with the Trading team to define project scope, requirements, and milestones

 - Prepare design documentation and actively participate in architectural discussions with team members

 - Build features in Go to enhance Talos's Order Management System (OMS), which is responsible for making all trading related decisions for orders submitted into Talos to ensure best execution

 - Add analytics and metrics to measure impact of your changes while incorporating feedback and iterating based on team input

 - Demonstrate project progress through regular demos




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Class of 2028 pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field

 - Proficiency in at least one compiled language (e.g., Go, C++, Java)

 - At least one previous internship involving working on backend systems in a production environment, preferably in a user-facing context

 - Knowledge of relational databases (e.g Postgres)

 - Past experience with trading systems is a plus

 - Detail-oriented, self driven, analytical, and enthusiastic about working on impactful projects

 - Strong communication skills, with an ability to convey technical concepts clearly

 - Ability to work autonomously as well as a part of a collaborative team environment

 - Energetic, creative, and a self-starter who can manage tasks autonomously

 - Local to NYC HQ




LEARN MORE ABOUT TALOS

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

 - Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW https://www.drw.com/vc/updates/drw-vc-portfolio-company-spotlight-anton-katz-talos/

 - Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-gDUxXkBMr8&t=62s/

 - Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More https://www.talos.com/

 - Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions https://www.talos.com/insights?insight-category=Case+Studies

 - Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024 https://www.talos.com/insights/talos-wins-best-trading-platform-at-hedgeweek-global-digital-assets-awards-2024/

 - Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team https://www.talos.com/insights/forbes-names-talos-one-of-americas-best-startup-employers-for-the-second-year-in-a-row/

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."




BENEFITS

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

 - A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

 - Evening socials with the entire office and fellow interns

 - Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks



Also, check out other open positions https://talos.com/company/#join-the-team listed on our website. Questions? Please contact earlycareers@talos.com http://talos.com.
